chapter.heading: Job 4
Eliphaz Speaks: The Innocent Prosper
chapter.v: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said :
Yet who can keep from speaking ?
and you havestrengthened the weak hands .
and you havemade firm the feeble knees .
it touches you , and you are dismayed .
and the integrity of your ways your hope ?
Or where were the upright cut off ?
and sow trouble reap the same .
and bythe blast of his anger they are consumed .
the teeth of the young lions are broken .
and the cubs of the lioness are scattered .
my ear receivedthe whisper of it .
whendeep sleep falls on men ,
which made all my bones shake .
the hair of my flesh stood up .
there was silence , then I hearda voice :
Can a man be pure before his Maker ?
and his angels he charges with error ;
who are crushed likethe moth .
they perish foreverwithout anyone regarding it .
do they not die , and that without wisdom ? ’
